speaker: barclay
caption: We cut the cord; the cord opened five tabs.
action: Both gentlemen sit square to the one marble counter, forearms resting on it, heads turned to each other; Barclay, wry, lips barely parted mid-word with no teeth or tongue showing, cradles his old fashioned on the slab; Drew, amused and settled, turns his martini by the stem where it stands on the marble; beyond the counter Abby, warm and genuinely smiling, polishes a glass with her plain white towel closed round it, her shoulders bare of any cloth.
tvPicture: a hand aims a remote at a large blank television above an empty couch, every screen and surface wordless
turn: hydra — one cord cut, five subscriptions sprout
